plan.title: Treatment x Time Interaction DE + Trajectory Analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a 2-condition x 4-timepoint (t0..t3) bulk RNA-seq time course in a human cell line, 3 replicates per cell (25 columns in counts.csv = 24 samples + gene symbol column; metadata.csv confirms 24 samples x condition/time/time_hours). The research question — which genes change over time in a treatment-specific way, beyond the shared time trend — is exactly the DESeq2 likelihood-ratio-test (LRT) time-course design: fit the full model ~condition + time + condition:time against the reduced model ~condition + time. Genes significant in this LRT have a time profile that differs by condition, independent of a shared temporal trend common to both conditions (which the reduced model absorbs). This is the grounded, knowledge-service-recommended approach for a time course with >=3 timepoints (rule R-0014), superseding a single Wald interaction coefficient which would only capture one pairwise time contrast. Given only 3 replicates per condition x time cell, the analysis is explicitly flagged as underpowered (rules R-0017, R-0063, R-0094): only genes with large, consistent condition-specific temporal divergence will be detected, and the report must state this rather than imply exhaustive discovery. The pipeline: (1) QC and sample-structure diagnostics on all 24 samples to confirm condition/time separation and detect outliers before modeling; (2) minimal count pre-filtering; (3) DESeq2 model fit with size-factor normalization internal to the model; (4) the condition:time LRT as the primary test, with per-timepoint simple-effect Wald contrasts (condition effect at each time point) reported alongside it for interpretability; (5) apeglm/ashr shrinkage of the simple-effect log2FCs for ranking and plotting; (6) BH-adjusted significance calling with independent filtering; (7) trajectory clustering of the LRT-significant genes so the treatment-specific patterns (e.g., divergent-only-late, divergent-only-early, opposite-direction) are visible rather than collapsed to one fold change; (8) fgsea preranked enrichment (Hallmark then Reactome, both staged locally for human) on the LRT statistic to interpret which pathways carry the treatment-specific temporal signal; (9) a consolidated report with all required reproducibility and power-caveat statements.

steps.method: keep genes with >=10 counts in >=3 samples (smallest group size)
DESeq2 LRT full vs reduced (drop condition:time)
apeglm shrinkage of condition:time interaction coefficients
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald/LRT stat, Hallmark then Reactome
trajectory clustering of significant genes + simple effects + interaction contrast + reproducibility record
